story_text.value:
Floppy Face is an app I built that transforms any selfie photo into a 3D head you can pull and stretch like the opening of Mario 64.

The app runs on Three.js and WebGL, so it performs smoothly on a browser or phone. When a photo is uploaded, Floppy Face uses MediaPipe to detect facial landmarks and map them onto a 468-point face template with estimated depth. The mesh is then subdivided for smoother stretching.

The app procedurally constructs the back of the head and uses sampled skin and hair colors to help blend it smoothly. The app then adds 3d-modeled ears and a Mario-inspired cap to complete the effect.

When a user pulls on the photo, a custom soft brush moves nearby vertices to deform the face in a smooth, predictable way. When you release, a custom spring effect creates a satisfying rubbery bounce.

title.value: Show HN: Turn any selfie into a 3D head you can stretch like Mario 64

story_text.value:
This is the developer of XDM

In a time of bunch of vibe coded download managers XDM one of the oldest open source downloader that is been serving as IDM alternative from 2013. Apart from a modern beutiful UI XDM now comes with torrent support powered by Libtorrent (the engine behind famous qBittorrent) and a new yt-dlp wrapper on top of XDM's built in browser extension based video grabber.

New features:

* Torrent and magnet link support

* Additional option for video download based on yt-dlp

* Lightweight but modern UI. XDM still runs under 50mb of RAM

* Brand new social media reels and profile downloader

Core features:

* Dynamic segmentation based battle tested multi threaded download engine

* Takes over downloads from browser and detects video playing in the browser

* Runs on Windows, Linux ( with native wayland support ) and macOS.

* Usual features: Pause/resume/refresh expired links, queue, scheduler, speed limit, custom actions after completion, proxy, authentication and many more.

* Android version soon

Please visit GitHub repo for more info: https://github.com/subhra74/xdm
